images.prompt: Darkfield microscope look: near-black background, objects visible only as bright scattering edges and internal granules in cool white and pale gold, faint coloured chloroplasts, small particles as sparkling points, shallow depth of field. Seen straight down, one Paramecium bursaria about 120 µm long filling the frame, its long axis horizontal with the front to the right: a broad slipper shape with a blunt rounded rear, the oral groove running diagonally from the front edge to the mouth at mid-length on the lower side. A thin luminous pellicle outline in cool white, the inside nearly black but packed with round green Chlorella (3 to 5 µm) and scattered pale-gold granules, a pale oval macronucleus in the middle and two star-shaped contractile vacuoles with radiating canals, one near each end. Draw the cilia only as a very faint short fringe (the game draws its own beating cilia). Flat #FF00FF background outside the cell. Scientifically grounded: match real microscopy of the named organisms and habitat, with correct anatomy and believable scale. No fantasy creatures, no faces, no glowing magic, no text, no labels, no scale bars, no watermark, no UI.
